name: ext4fuse
description: Read-only implementation of ext4 for FUSE

readme.summary: Well-structured README with excellent installation instructions and clear purpose, but lacking comprehensive configuration options and usage examples.
readme.top_issue: Missing documentation of available mount options and configuration flags beyond the basic mounting command

injection_risks.description: Use of system calls like disk_read and disk_open without proper validation of input parameters
Use of strncpy which may lead to buffer overflow if not properly validated

critical_findings: Potential buffer overflow in dcache_insert function
Lack of input validation for disk file path and name parameters
security.summary: The code has some security concerns, including potential injection risks, lack of input validation, and error exposure, but no critical secrets or dangerous defaults were found.

common_complaints: Installation failures on macOS (Linux requirement errors, M1/Apple Silicon incompatibility)
Read-only mount restrictions, no write support
Permission access issues with home folders and protected directories
Compatibility problems with recent macOS versions (Monterey, Ventura, Sonoma)
Mounting succeeds but files inaccessible or unmountable
praise_themes: Project is useful for data recovery scenarios
Community members willing to contribute improvements
sentiment.summary: ext4fuse shows severe abandonment with 12 open issues spanning 9 years, zero maintainer engagement, persistent platform incompatibilities, and unresolved feature requests—community frustration is high due to installation blockers and fundamental limitations.

concerns: No commits in nearly 3 years (last commit April 2021)
39 open issues with no recent activity
Zero closed issues in past 6 months
No merged PRs in past 6 months
No active contributors in past 6 months
maintenance.summary: ext4fuse is abandoned with no development activity since 2021 and a growing backlog of unresolved issues.

analysis_summary.doc_summary: The README provides clear and concise information, but lacks detailed examples and configuration documentation.
